name: GPU FinOps, Resource Sharing & Cost Optimization
description: Maximizing GPU hardware efficiency and minimizing cloud spend: NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), GPU time-slicing, Spot instance orchestration, interruption handling, FinOps cost allocation, and model right-sizing.

subskills.name: NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) Partitioning
subskills.description: Partitioning A100/H100 GPUs into isolated hardware instances (e.g. 1g.10gb, 3g.40gb) with dedicated compute, memory, and hardware QoS.

subskills.name: GPU Time-Slicing & Fractional GPU Sharing
subskills.description: Configuring Kubernetes GPU time-slicing configurations to share non-MIG GPUs across multiple inference microservice pods.

subskills.name: Spot Instance Orchestration & Fault Tolerance
subskills.description: Running training jobs on cheap Spot/Preemptible instances with automated checkpointing, spot interruption notice listeners, and auto-resumption.

subskills.name: GPU Utilization Profiling (NVIDIA DCGM / Nsight)
subskills.description: Monitoring GPU duty cycle, memory bandwidth utilization, tensor core activity, and identifying underutilized 'zombie' GPU allocations with DCGM.

subskills.name: FinOps Cost Allocation & Kubecost for ML
subskills.description: Allocating GPU/CPU compute costs per team, project, and model using Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer tags, and tracking cost-per-inference.

subskills.name: Inference Right-Sizing (CPU vs GPU vs Specialized ASICs)
subskills.description: Benchmarking workloads to determine the most cost-effective hardware: modern CPUs (Intel Xeon AVX-512), cost-efficient GPUs (T4, L4), or AWS Inferentia / Trainium.

subskills.name: Auto-Termination of Idle Clusters & Development Pods
subskills.description: Implementing automated shutdown of idle Jupyter/training pods and scaling development inference endpoints to zero after business hours.

subskills.name: Model Compaction for Lower GPU Tiers (A100 -> L4/T4)
subskills.description: Applying INT8/FP16 quantization to compress models so they fit on cost-effective 24GB L4/T4 GPUs instead of expensive 80GB A100s.

subskills.name: Savings Plans, Reserved Instances & Capacity Blocks
subskills.description: Strategic commitment modeling: Compute Savings Plans, 1-year/3-year Reserved Instances, and AWS EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML training reservations.

cv.signal: Reduced cloud ML spend by 60% by implementing Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), Spot orchestration, and Kubecost FinOps

linkedin.signal: GPU FinOps, Cloud Cost Optimization, and MIG endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes GPU FinOps, Resource Sharing & Cost Optimization Assessment

junior.description: Monitors GPU utilization with DCGM, configures auto-termination of idle dev pods, and quantizes models to fit smaller VRAM.

mid.description: Configures GPU time-slicing sharing, runs resilient training on Spot instances with automated checkpoints, and tracks Kubecost cost-per-inference.

senior.description: Architects NVIDIA MIG hardware partitioning for high-density serving and formulates enterprise GPU reservation & Savings Plan strategies.
